name: @pylon-cloud/pylonsync-site
description: pylonsync.com — the Pylon framework marketing site. A Pylon app with no entities and no database: SSR pages plus two stateless relay functions.
//workspaces: For the Docker build ONLY. The image installs at /app with THIS file as /app/package.json and packages/ui copied to /app/packages/ui, so bun needs a workspace root there to resolve the `workspace:*` dependency below. In the repo checkout this field is inert — the root package.json already owns the workspace and bun ignores a nested declaration.
